import { NestFactory } from '@nestjs/core';
import { AppModule, AuditGuard, AuthGuard } from './modules';

// CASE:bootstrap-global-guards
async function bootstrap(): Promise<void> {
  const app = await NestFactory.create(AppModule);
  app.useGlobalGuards(new AuthGuard(), new AuditGuard());
}

// CASE:bootstrap-escaped-app
async function unsupportedBootstrap(register: (app: unknown) => void): Promise<void> {
  const app = await NestFactory.create(AppModule);
  register(app);
}

void bootstrap;
void unsupportedBootstrap;
